papers.title: OpenCossan 2.0: an efficient computational toolbox for risk, reliability and resilience analysis
papers.abstract: Many complex phenomena and the analysis of large and complex system and network can only be studied<br/>adopting advanced computational methods. In addition, in many engineering fields virtual prototypes are used to support<br/>and drive the design of new components, structures and systems. Uncertainty quantification is a key requirement and<br/>challenge for a realistic and reliable numerical modelling and prediction that spans across various disciplines and industry<br/>as well.<br/>The treatment of uncertainty required the availability of efficient algorithms and computational techniques able to<br/>reduce the computational cost required by the non-deterministic analysis and to interface with opensource and commercial<br/>model (e.g. FE/CFD) and libraries. In order to satisfy these requirements and allowing the inclusion of non-deterministic<br/>analyses as a practice standard routing in scientific computing, a general purpose software for uncertainty quantification<br/>and risk assessment, named COSSAN, is under continuous development.<br/>This paper presents an overview of the main capabilities of the recent release of the Matlab open source toolboxes<br/>OPENCOSSAN. The new release includes interfaces with 3rd party libraries allowing to couple OPENCOSSAN with the<br/>state-of-the-art tools in Machine Learning and Meta-modelling. In addition, new toolboxes for reliability and resilient<br/>analysis of system and network are also presented. OPENCOSSAN is released under the Lesser GNU licence. It is<br/>therefore freely available. It is also be package as a Python or Java library for distribution to end users who do not need<br/>MATLAB.
papers.venue: TU/e Research Portal (Eindhoven University of Technology)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了一个用于不确定性量化和可靠性分析的开源工具箱，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模和不确定性处理。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a general-purpose UQ toolbox without specific application to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on biomedical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为复杂工程系统提供高效的不确定性量化与可靠性分析工具。
summary_zh.method: 开发了Matlab开源工具箱OpenCossan 2.0，集成机器学习与元建模接口。
summary_zh.result: 实现了与第三方库的耦合，支持可靠性和弹性分析，并打包为Python/Java库。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供具体验证案例，仅描述工具箱功能。

summary_en.motivation: To provide efficient algorithms and computational techniques for uncertainty quantification and risk assessment in complex engineering systems.
summary_en.method: Developed the OpenCossan 2.0 Matlab toolbox with interfaces to machine learning and metamodeling libraries, supporting reliability and resilience analysis.
summary_en.result: The toolbox enables coupling with third-party solvers and is distributed as open-source under LGPL, with Python/Java packaging for broader accessibility.
summary_en.validation: No specific validation case is presented; the paper focuses on software capabilities and architecture.
